BL-1533 — bl604TrendAnalysisInvariants.property.test.js is flaky red on main with no owner: invariant 1 asserts a reach floor of 10 on the up and down delta signs but only ever SAMPLES them (12 draws of small series sets in the many bucket, expectation near the floor), so the file fails on roughly one seed in seven with 'reach floor: delta sign up drawn 9 < 10' - the sign is constructed the way the length buckets already are, and the floors stay
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: extension/src is not edited - computeTrend, buildTrendAnalysis and renderTrendAnalysisSection are BL-604's landed contract and the property agrees with them on every draw; the fix is in…
